title: COCO-CMFD: A Synthetic Copy-Move Forgery Dataset with Source/Target Ground Truth
description:
COCO-CMFD is a synthetic copy-move forgery dataset generated from MS-COCO 2017 for training and evaluating copy-move forgery detection (CMFD) models. Each sample takes one annotated COCO object, applies a mild affine transform, and pastes it elsewhere in the same image at a location that passes scene-plausibility checks (support surface, horizon band, perspective scale, occlusion).

Ground truth is provided at four granularities: a 3-class trimap (background / source / target), a binary mask, a 16-pixel patch-label grid using a strict purity rule, and a hard-negative mask covering the scene's other annotated objects.

Release v1.1 contains 8,245 samples drawn from 4,788 distinct COCO train2017 images across 63 categories, at native COCO resolution with no post-processing applied. Blending uses an inward-only feather so every modified pixel lies inside the labelled ground truth: measured mask-alignment IoU is 1.0000 (minimum 0.9997 over 60 sampled images), with zero pixels changed outside any mask.

This repository holds the generation pipeline and quality tooling. Generation is deterministic and resumable; the released dataset used seed 1337. The dataset itself is distributed via Hugging Face in parquet and WebDataset formats.

This record archives the code and documentation, licensed MIT. The dataset on Hugging Face is released in four parts, each under the Creative Commons licence its source photographs allow (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-NC 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); samples from photographs whose licence forbids adaptations are excluded. COCO annotations are CC BY 4.0; COCO images are Flickr photographs that keep their owners' licences, recorded per sample. See LICENSING.md.
